about: Reminders the game schedules on the phone (src/game/notifications.js), picked at random. {truck} is the player's current truck, {map} the map last driven, {client} a mission client. Keep them short, friendly and never pushy.

messages.title: The mud is calling
messages.body: Your {truck} hasn't been dirty in days. {map} misses you.

messages.title: Deep bog ahead
messages.body: Lock the DIFF, drop to low range, and show {map} who's boss.

messages.title: New contracts in
messages.body: Fresh missions are waiting in the garage. Somebody has to haul it.

messages.title: {client} called
messages.body: They need a driver who doesn't get stuck. Is that you?

messages.title: Engine's warm
messages.body: Your {truck} is idling in the bay. One quick run before dinner?

messages.title: Signature haul
messages.body: Every truck has a job of its own. Have you done your {truck}'s yet?

messages.title: Storm rolling in
messages.body: Thunder over Monsoon Canopy. Perfect weather for a rescue run.

messages.title: Leaves are falling
messages.body: Copper Ridge's logging roads are slick with autumn leaves. Mind the logs.

messages.title: The volcano is grumbling
messages.body: Cinder Caldera needs supplies before the next eruption window.

messages.title: Dust devils spotted
messages.body: Coyote Wash is wide open. The tumbleweeds are faster than you.

messages.title: Your rank is waiting
messages.body: A few more runs and the next truck in every class is yours.

messages.title: Upgrade time
messages.body: Max out your {truck} and it'll never get stuck. With AWD and DIFF on.

messages.title: Pothole report
messages.body: The trail at {map} has been quiet. Too quiet.

messages.title: The depot is open
messages.body: Loads are stacked and nobody's driving. Grab your keys.

messages.title: Coins on the trail
messages.body: Rocks to crush, bogs to clear, coins to collect. Easy money. Ish.

messages.title: Who's the heaviest?
messages.body: Have you tried a mining giant through Gumbo Bottoms yet? Bold move.

messages.title: Bayou Doctor
messages.body: The stilt houses past the gator crossing need their medicine. Keep it cool.

messages.title: Balance check
messages.body: Easy on the gas, tap the brake, keep it on four wheels. Ready?

messages.title: Meltwater Pass is open
messages.body: One afternoon before the next storm. Beat the melt.

messages.title: Trucker's break is over
messages.body: Your {truck} is fuelled, tuned and bored.

messages.title: The quarry needs you
messages.body: Slatecut Quarry has blast rock all over the haul road.

messages.title: Elephant on board?
messages.body: Some trucks carry logs. Some carry elephants. Find out which you've got.

messages.title: Mud season
messages.body: There's never been a better day to get stuck and unstuck.
